verses.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?

xrefs.text: And He will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what His eyes see, and He will not decide by what His ears hear,

For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.
A Psalm of Asaph. God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:

verses.text: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.

xrefs.text: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally— one devising mischief by decree?
Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees,
Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.
Then I said: “Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?
Furthermore, I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there is wickedness, and in the place of righteousness there is wickedness.

verses.text: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.

xrefs.text: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
You have never heard; you have never understood; for a long time your ears have not been open. For I knew how deceitful you are; you have been called a rebel from birth.
Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.
What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.text: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,

xrefs.text: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
“For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
If the snake bites before it is charmed, there is no profit for the charmer.
“Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”

Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be emptied out from among them, and I will frustrate their plans, so that they will resort to idols and spirits of the dead, to mediums and spiritists.

verses.text: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.

xrefs.text: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.
The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.

Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it passes through, with no one to rescue them.
Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

verses.text: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.

xrefs.text: And the men of Ai struck down about thirty-six of them, chasing them from the gate as far as the quarries and striking them down on the slopes. So the hearts of the people melted and became like water.
The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; trembling will seize the leaders of Moab; those who dwell in Canaan will melt away,
who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
Therefore all hands will fall limp, and every man’s heart will melt.

verses.text: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.

xrefs.text: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?

A man may father a hundred children and live for many years; yet no matter how long he lives, if he is unsatisfied with his prosperity and does not even receive a proper burial, I say that a stillborn child is better off than he.
I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

verses.text: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry— He will sweep them away.

xrefs.text: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
For like the crackling of thorns under the pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This too is futile.
Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
The nations rage like the rush of many waters. He rebukes them, and they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.

verses.text: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.

xrefs.text: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.

Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His children. He will take vengeance on His adversaries and repay those who hate Him; He will cleanse His land and His people.

verses.text: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”

xrefs.text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
